title: Trip Around The Sun
meta_description: Sleek coastal contemporary design perfectly situated to capture gulf views and masterfully configured providing unparalleled amenities including a massive private resort style pool area complete with a stone waterfall feature and swim up bar.
description_expanded: *Home Highlights* -Private pool with swim-up bar & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $90 per day from October 1-May 1) -Gulf views -Six-Seater golf cart included -6 bikes Included -Elevator Just a stone's throw away from the pristine, sugar-white sands of the Gulf of Mexico lies the delightful vacation home, 'Trip Around the Sun.' This expansive beach destination is brimming with both indoor and outdoor activities, making it the perfect choice for large groups and unforgettable celebrations. Sleek coastal contemporary design perfectly situated to capture gulf views and masterfully configured providing unparalleled amenities including a massive private resort style pool area complete with a stone waterfall feature and swim up bar as well as an adjoining spa and covered outdoor summer kitchen and living area. This home was designed to maximize functionality and finely appointed with chic contemporary finishes while affording optimal comfort & living space. Notable features include multiple indoor and outdoor living areas, private commercial grade elevator, dual master suites with gulf views, built-in pinterest style bunk beds, as well as indoor and outdoor surround sound system. The first floor layout boasts dual bunk rooms, a large bedroom with ensuite bath as well as an industrial style game room complete with a pool table & built in wet bar including a full size Sub-Zero fridge. The second floor is the focal point of indoor living space with a spacious living room featuring pecky cypress beamed ceilings. Destin, Florida is renowned for its abundance of beach and tourist activities, making it one of the most sought-after vacation destinations in the nation. Our luxury homes in Destin offer a unique blend of opulence and privacy, while still capturing the lively and vibrant energy of a thriving beach town. Whether you choose to bask in the tranquility of 'Trip Around the Sun' or seek out adventurous excursions, Echelon ensures that your vacation experience aligns perfectly with your vision. The property includes on-site parking for up to 8 vehicles. *Sleeping Accommodations* First Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Bunk Nook: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed Half Bath Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Half Bath Third Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed and One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower
